Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1243
Claimant:
Jonathan Cox
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
April 18, 2025
First notice of loss received from the insured's driver reporting a rear-end collision at a signalized intersection, with
the claimant's vehicle stopped in front. A claim file has been opened and the policy was confirmed active with the
driver listed as a named driver.
May 4, 2025
Spoke with the claimant's representing attorney, who confirmed the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of the
collision and is reporting neck pain consistent with whiplash. A letter of representation is on file and all further contact
will go through counsel.
June 3, 2025
Reviewed the police report, which confirms the claimant's vehicle was stopped and was struck from behind, and the
responding officer documented the claimant at the scene. No independent witnesses were identified in the report.
June 11, 2025
Photographs of both vehicles were received and reviewed. They confirm the general location of the damage, and the
rear damage on the claimant's vehicle is mostly in line with the impact described by the insured's driver.
August 1, 2025
Took a recorded statement from the claimant through counsel. The account of how the collision happened matches
what was described in the first notice, and the claimant has given the same account in every conversation so far.
August 23, 2025
Ran a prior-claims and records check on the claimant's vehicle. No earlier damage to the same areas is known, and
nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the coverage start date on the policy.
August 24, 2025
Received the initial medical records. The treatment plan is a usual course for a soft-tissue neck injury of this kind, and
the reported injury matches the type and force of the crash well. No eralier injury to the same body area is known
from the records provided.
August 26, 2025
Requested an independent medical review of the records to check the treatment against the reported injury. The
reviewer's preliminary comments indicate the care has been reasonable for the diagnosis.
September 1, 2025
Follow-up treatment notes show the claimant's physical therapy visits have been tapering off as symptoms improve.
The provider's notes describe steady progress with fewer complaints at each visit.
October 30, 2025
Discussed the file status with the claims supervisor. Liability is clear on the insured's side, and the damage and injury
picture is consistent with the reported facts, so the claim is moving toward a settlement evaluation.
November 18, 2025
Sent a status update to counsel requesting the final bills and the treatment summary. Settlement evaluation will be
completed once those documents are received.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
